cohort: 200 pregnant women who had USG findings of uterine fibroids were enrolled in the study.
finding: Pregnancies with uterine fibroids are often asymptomatic but are associated with increased risks of complications such as threatened preterm labor, threatened abortion, PROM, malpresentation, PPH, and a high rate of cesarean section, thus making them high-risk pregnancies.
mod_finding: The most common mode of delivery was cesarean section (62%), followed by vaginal delivery (25%), indicating a high rate of cesarean section in pregnant patients with uterine fibroids.
